name: Iris Burst
author: E. T. Carter
description: A starburst iris filling the frame: where the base iris has a dark pupil, burst inverts it into a hot near-white core that throws long thin sharp rays out past the corners. A few dominant spikes dominate among many fine ones like a lens star, each twinkling on its own phase, colour saturating from white at the core to hue along the rays.

params.label: Rays
params.effect: Number of rays around the circle; fewer reads as a bold few-spoke star, more as a fine sunburst halo.

params.label: Sharpness
params.effect: Thinness of each ray; 0 gives broad soft wedges, 1 gives needle-thin crisp spikes.

params.label: Twinkle
params.effect: Rate at which rays pulse in brightness on their own phases; 0 holds them steady, higher shimmers.

params.label: Core heat
params.effect: Radius of the hot near-white core the rays erupt from; larger floods more of the centre with light.
